        if self.render_mode == "debug":
            state = f"""
    ###############################################
    round {self.V[self.ROUND]}

    -----------------------------------------------
    last action: {self.curr_action} (min: {self.Amin}, max: {self.Amax})

    Sanitation: {self.curr_action[0]} (min: {self.Amin[0]}, max: {self.Amax[0]})
    Production: {self.curr_action[1]} (min: {self.Amin[1]}, max: {self.Amax[1]})
    Education: {self.curr_action[2]} (min: {self.Amin[2]}, max: {self.Amax[2]})
    Quality of Life: {self.curr_action[3]} (min: {self.Amin[3]}, max: {self.Amax[3]})
    Population Growth: {self.curr_action[4]} (min: {self.Amin[4]}, max: {self.Amax[4]})

    Population Growth additional points: {self.curr_action[5]} (min: {self.Amin[5]}, max: {self.Amax[5]})
    additional points can be spent on Population Growth if Education is above 20,
    and the amount of additional points depends on the level of Education.
    If Education is below 21, no additional points can be spent on Population Growth.

    Number of additional points that can be spent on Population Growth based on current level of Education:
    Education 21-23: up to 3 additional points
    Education 24-27: up to 4 additional points
    Education 28-29: up to 5 additional points

    -----------------------------------------------

    Sanitation:        {self.V[self.SANITATION]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.SANITATION]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.SANITATION]})
    Production:        {self.V[self.PRODUCTION]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.PRODUCTION]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.PRODUCTION]})
    Education:         {self.V[self.EDUCATION]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.EDUCATION]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.EDUCATION]})
    Quality of Life:   {self.V[self.QUALITY_OF_LIFE]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.QUALITY_OF_LIFE]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.QUALITY_OF_LIFE]})
    Population Growth: {self.V[self.POPULATION_GROWTH]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.POPULATION_GROWTH]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.POPULATION_GROWTH]})
    Environment:       {self.V[self.ENVIRONMENT]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.ENVIRONMENT]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.ENVIRONMENT]})
    Population:        {self.V[self.POPULATION]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.POPULATION]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.POPULATION]})
    Politics:          {self.V[self.POLITICS]} (min: {self.Vmin[self.POLITICS]}, max: {self.Vmax[self.POLITICS]})

    Action points:     {self.V[self.POINTS]}
    round {self.V[self.ROUND]}
    ###############################################
    """
